name: JM Default Execution Body v0.1 — Ordered State / Ding Recovery Proof Receipt
purpose: Prove that an authorized JM build can move through explicit execution states, cannot skip proof gates to claim PASS, can route a Ding locally through ESCALATED and recovery, and can close its execution route without manufacturing product capability, contact, freeze, anchor or mount claims.

implementation.route_rule: Execution initializes only from a prospective Build Route Manifest with state.build_authorized_by_manifest=true.
implementation.capability_rule: Build authorization and true_gaps.new_capability_creation_authorized are independent. A reuse-only route can execute with new capability authorization false.
implementation.closure_boundary: CLOSED proves only execution-route closure. It does not itself claim freeze, lock, anchor, mount, runtime contact or crown status.

live_proof.job_name: Route serious bodies through intake and execution

sequence.claim_boundary: CONTACTABLE only proves a synthetic test/contact route for the execution mechanism, not actual end-user contact.

sequence.observed: ValueError: PASS blocked by OPEN/FAIL gates: ['runtime-probe']
sequence.meaning: The execution ledger could not paper over an OPEN native/proof gate.
Synthetic Ding remained local and traceable.
Recovery returned only to the affected proof state for retest.

live_proof.final_observed: JM Default Execution Body live proof PASS: ordered execution, OPEN-block, Ding escalation, recovery, PASS and truthful CLOSED state verified; no product capability or freeze/mount claim manufactured.

proves: ESCALATED records and returns to resume_state only after red gate clears

non_claims: The synthetic execution probe does not prove a product runtime or user contact surface.
The execution ledger records evidence references; it does not manufacture the evidence.
CLOSED is not a crown and is not automatically frozen, locked, anchored or mounted.
No new product capability was authorized or created by the live execution probe.
proof_result: PASS — AUTHORIZED -> ORDERED EXECUTION -> OPEN BLOCK -> DING -> LOCAL RECOVERY -> RETEST -> PASS -> TRUTHFUL CLOSED
governing_result: The JM default can now govern not only how a serious build enters, but how an authorized build moves. State changes are ordered, evidence-backed, exception-routed and claim-bounded rather than inferred from activity or paperwork volume.
